_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. Must be built from the td-load-rrip-min-extrapolate branch (adds td_combined_on_mlc: the combined L2 marked-RRIP policy protecting both membound data lines and front-end-bound instruction lines with per-class knobs).
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'.
_simulations: Combined L2 marked-RRIP effective-depth study. Prior sweeps found each class saturates its benefit at its OWN depth -- instructions ~-48, data ~-32 -- with no benefit beyond the max, and the two are NOT zero-sum: unqualified lines of both classes (below their gate) stay at basic, leaving eviction slack so both classes can hold their effective depth at once. This descriptor gives each class its known-effective depth together (the headline config), isolates each class alone to measure additivity, and probes each axis only BELOW its max (never past it) to see whether combination lets a shallower depth suffice. Thresholds are pinned (instr td_fe_rrip_thresh=0.7, data td_load_replay_thresh=0.5), both classes fixed-min (no extrapolation); only the two depths vary and never exceed the per-class max. 'off' = that class's min RRPV set to basic (2), so it inserts unprotected. Compare IPC / ICACHE_MISS / DCACHE_MISS_LD vs. baseline with plot_stat_change.py.
_configurations: baseline = untouched L2. instr_only_i48 / data_only_d32 = one class at its effective depth, the other at basic (additivity baselines). both_i48_d32 = headline: both classes at their effective depth at once. both_i32_d32 probes a shallower instruction depth (does -32 suffice while data stays -32); both_i48_d16 probes a shallower data depth (does -16 suffice while instr stays -48). No config exceeds the per-class max (-48 instr / -32 data).

instr_only_i48._params: Instructions at their effective depth -48; data unprotected (basic). Isolates the instruction gain.

data_only_d32._params: Data at its effective depth -32; instructions unprotected (basic). Isolates the data gain.

both_i48_d32._params: HEADLINE: instructions -48 AND data -32 together (both at their effective depth; non-zero-sum test).

both_i32_d32._params: Instruction depth probe (below max): instructions -32, data -32.

both_i48_d16._params: Data depth probe (below max): instructions -48, data -16.

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Visualization settings for ./sci --visualize. Configure baseline and counters.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
